Russia practices cruise missile launches over Barents Sea in 'Zapad' drills with Belarus
articles.lede: Russia practices cruise missile launches over Barents Sea in 'Zapad' drills with Belarus. MOSCOW (Reuters) -Russian Tu-160 strategic bomber planes performed combat training missions over the Barents Sea during joint military exercises with Belarus and practiced launching cruise missiles, the Russian Defence Ministry said on Tuesday. Russia and Belarus are wrapping up five days of war games, codenamed Zapad (West), in a show of force that they say is designed to test combat readiness. The drills - taking place days after Polish and NATO forces shot down Russian drones that entered Polish airspace - have unnerved some neighbouring countries. articles.title: Washington Calls for 'Complete' Dismantling of Iran's Uranium-Enrichment Program
articles.lede: Washington Calls for ‘Complete’ Dismantling of Iran’s Uranium-Enrichment Program. Iran's nuclear program must be “completely dismantled,” US Energy Secretary Chris Wright told the UN nuclear watchdog's annual General Conference on Monday. “If it wasn’t already clear enough, I will restate the United States’ position on Iran. Iran’s nuclear weapons pathway, including all (uranium) enrichment and (plutonium) reprocessing capabilities, must be completely dismantled,” Wright said in a speech to a meeting of all International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) member states.
